name: Heartleaf Philodendron
hook: Yellow lower leaves? Too much water or too little light.

steps.title: Indirect light, no hot sun
steps.tip: Bright, indirect light is best, but it copes with low light. Direct summer sun scorches the leaves.

steps.title: Let the top dry first
steps.tip: Water when the top of the soil is dry, less in winter, and never let the pot stand in water.

steps.title: Keep it above 15°C
steps.tip: Keep it at 15°C or warmer, away from hot radiators and cold drafts.

steps.title: Feed April to September
steps.tip: Use a diluted houseplant fertilizer while it grows. Too much makes the leaf tips curl and turn brown.

steps.title: Trim and root the cuttings
steps.tip: In spring, cut long stems back just after a leaf node. 10 cm cuttings root in water in about 2 weeks.

steps.title: Check for mealybugs
steps.tip: Check now and then for mealybugs, spider mites, scale and aphids.

outro: Go easy on the water and it will keep growing long vines.

sources.title: NC State Plant Toolbox: Philodendron hederaceum
